speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have significant constitutional symptoms like fever, night sweats, and weight loss alongside abdominal pain and an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node. These signs suggest a systemic process, possibly malignancy or an infection. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, stool color, or appetite recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning. Have you noticed any blood in your stool, or have you experienced unintentional weight loss alongside these night sweats? Also, have you had any recent fevers or night sweats that wake you from sleep?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma (specifically involving the abdomen and supraclavicular nodes with B-symptoms)

REQUEST TEST: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast, LDH, and CBC with differential.
REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide the CT scan and any physical exam images of the neck mass.
